description: Core marketing concepts, frameworks, digital marketing, and consumer behavior

marketing_mix_4ps.product: What you sell; features, quality, branding, packaging, lifecycle
marketing_mix_4ps.price: What customers pay; pricing strategy, discounts, payment terms
marketing_mix_4ps.place: Distribution channels; where customers access the product
marketing_mix_4ps.promotion: How you communicate; advertising, PR, sales, social media

market_segmentation.behavioral: Purchase behavior, usage rate, loyalty, benefits sought
market_segmentation.positioning: How brand is perceived relative to competitors in target customer's mind

cognitive_biases.anchoring: First piece of information heavily influences decision
cognitive_biases.loss_aversion: Losses feel twice as painful as equivalent gains

brand_management.brand_equity: Added value brand name gives to product

digital_marketing.seo: Search Engine Optimization; organic search visibility
digital_marketing.sem: Search Engine Marketing; paid search (Google Ads)
digital_marketing.content_marketing: Create valuable content to attract and engage audience
digital_marketing.email_marketing: Highest ROI of digital channels; $36 return per $1 spent
digital_marketing.influencer: Leverage social media personalities for brand promotion

key_metrics.ctr: Click-Through Rate; percentage who click on ads
key_metrics.cpm: Cost Per Mille; cost per 1,000 impressions
key_metrics.conversion_rate: Percentage of visitors who take desired action
key_metrics.churn_rate: Percentage of customers who stop buying
key_metrics.ltv_cac_ratio: Customer Lifetime Value / Customer Acquisition Cost; healthy ratio >3:1

pricing_strategies.value_based: Price based on perceived customer value
pricing_strategies.penetration: Low initial price to gain market share
pricing_strategies.skimming: High initial price, decrease over time (tech products)
pricing_strategies.dynamic: Prices change based on demand (airlines, Uber)
pricing_strategies.freemium: Basic product free; charge for premium features
